_meta.description: Known address labels for fund tracing classification
_meta.intents_solvers_note: Cross-chain intents/bridge SOLVER + settlement addresses. Funds that reach one may 'fly off' to another chain via an off-chain order book (coins commingle in the solver's pool, value re-emerges elsewhere). On hit: look up the intent (e.g. explorer.near-intents.org by address) before concluding a destination. Grow this list as solvers are identified.
_meta.kucoin_cluster_note: KuCoin hot/consolidation wallets share vanity suffixes …627e and …6933. Intake 0xabde75 forwards EXCLUSIVELY into this cluster => it is KuCoin's own infra, not a third party banking at KuCoin. Reaching it = a KYC'd-exchange deposit (identity/recovery lead), subject to the deposit-vs-nested-service caveat.
_meta.no_kyc_swap_note: Custodial coin-swap services (BTC in -> other-asset out from their inventory). Custody hand-off + coins!=value, same failure mode as intents. Most are OPAQUE (no public API) — stop honestly, report 'unresolved/possible off-chain exit'. Exceptions with resolvable APIs: SideShift (public /api/v2/shifts/{id}).
